title: Oil of Diminution

sources.title: Throw
markers: thrown weapons do not apply any innate extra damage

summary: Coated hits can Reduce a target, but the coating lowers weapon enchantment by 1.

fields.Coat: Bonus Action, single use. Coat the active weapon set for 10 turns. Both equipped weapons in that set are coated when dual wielding. Another set needs its own dose. Replaces a dip or another coating. Throwing the bottle does not apply an area coating.
fields.Weapon penalty: −1 weapon enchantment while coated, lowering eligible attack and damage rolls by 1.
fields.On hit: One target per attack makes a DC 11 Constitution save. On failure, Reduced for 2 turns gives Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves and subtracts 1d4 from melee damage. The target shrinks and loses 25% carrying capacity. Reduced does not stack. The generic condition lists weapon damage, while the coating specifically describes melee damage.
fields.Thrown weapon: The general Throw rules omit weapon coating effects when a weapon is thrown.
fields.Crafting: Extract 3 Sylvan Stones into Essence of Sylvan Stone, then combine with any Suspension.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
